en.headline: Centre for Health Protection confirms new local mpox case
en.dek: A 31-year-old man is in stable condition under isolation at Princess Margaret Hospital after testing positive; he reported high-risk contact with multiple strangers in Hong Kong during the incubation period.
body: The Centre for Health Protection is investigating a confirmed local case of mpox involving a 31-year-old man who is receiving isolation treatment at Princess Margaret Hospital and is in stable condition.

The patient developed a rash on his genital area from 27 July and attended a Department of Health male social hygiene clinic on Monday. Because of a history of high-risk contact, samples were taken and laboratory testing confirmed the presence of the mpox virus.

According to information provided by the patient, he had high-risk contact with multiple strangers in Hong Kong during the incubation period. The Centre said there was so far no epidemiological link between this case and previously recorded mpox cases in the city.
The Centre continues to urge high-risk groups to receive mpox vaccination and advises the public to avoid close physical contact with anyone suspected of having the infection.

zh.headline: 衞生防護中心確認一宗本地猴痘個案 31歲男子情況穩定
zh.dek: 患者於瑪嘉烈醫院接受隔離治療，潛伏期內曾在港與多名陌生男子有高風險接觸，暫未發現與早前個案有流行病學關連。
body: 衞生防護中心表示，正調查一宗本地感染的猴痘確診個案，涉及一名31歲男子。他現於瑪嘉烈醫院接受隔離治療，目前情況穩定。
患者自上月27日起生殖器官出現皮疹，並於星期一到衞生署男性社會衞生科診所求診。由於他曾有高風險接觸史，醫護人員為其採集樣本，經中心公共衞生化驗服務處化驗後，結果對猴痘病毒呈陽性反應。
根據病人提供的資料，他於潛伏期內曾在香港與多名陌生男子有高風險接觸。中心暫未發現任何資料顯示這宗個案與本港早前錄得的其他猴痘確診個案有流行病學關連。
中心強烈建議高風險目標群組人士接種猴痘疫苗，並提醒市民避免與懷疑感染猴痘的人士作密切身體接觸。
